headerDisplay: Read-only Rivian status in Apple Home. Sign in above; your password is not saved, only the session token Rivian returns.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to read the vehicle's last-known state from Rivian's cloud. Reading does not wake the vehicle.

showCharge.title: Charge level tile
showCharge.description: Shows the charge % on its own tile. Home only shows a percentage on a tile for humidity sensors, so it appears as one in details and automations.

showPluggedIn.title: Plugged In sensor (shows Detected when the charge cable is connected)

showRangeSensor.title: Range as a light sensor (lux = miles or km)
showRangeSensor.description: HomeKit has no range type, so this reports range as a light level. Useful for automations like "when range drops below 50".
